verdict.rationale: PostHog docs explicitly state you can build insights, save them to dashboards, share them, and 'get alerted when they move' (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25), directly supporting dashboard subscriptions and abnormal-metric alerts. However, there's no evidence of subscription mechanics (email/Slack digest cadence, per-user subscription management) or of anomaly-detection specifics beyond the phrase 'get alerted when they move'. Missing for 10: documentation on subscription setup/notification channels, anomaly detection thresholds/algorithms, and independent/hands-on confirmation that alerts work reliably.
